title: Seller Performance Standing — Appeals Against a Suspension
content:
**Rule.** Submitting an appeal is the seller's own act and is confirmed by the seller. An appeal is submitted no later than the appeal window counted in calendar days from the suspension date, and no more than the per-suspension appeal limit may be submitted. When the suspension stems from a violation type listed in the plan-of-action required types, the appeal must be a plan of action; an appeal on another basis is rejected. An appeal is accepted when its basis is supported by the records: a plan of action addressing every active violation, or a "violation issued in error" appeal where the violation record shows the listing was not active, the complaint was retracted, or the violation was recorded twice. Acceptance reinstates the seller and releases the payments hold; rejection returns the record to suspended with the appeal count unchanged.

## The appeal window

The clock starts on the suspension date shown on the seller's Seller Performance Standing record — the system record, not the seller's account of when the suspension began. The window is counted in calendar days from that date, and an appeal must be submitted **no later than** its last day; submission on the last day is within the window.

| Hypothetical appeal date | Within the window? |
|---|---|
| The suspension date plus 30 calendar days (the last day of a 30-day window) | yes — on the boundary day |
| The suspension date plus 31 calendar days | no — after the window |

## Counting appeals against one suspension

The appeals counted against a suspension are the seller's appeals submitted on or after the current suspension date. A rejected appeal still counts: rejection leaves the appeal count unchanged.

## Status path

| Step | Status |
|---|---|
| The seller submits an appeal | suspended to under appeal; the date of the latest appeal is recorded |
| The appeal is accepted | under appeal to good standing; the reinstatement date is recorded, the suspension date is cleared and the payments hold is released |
| The appeal is rejected | under appeal back to suspended |

## Which basis is accepted

| Suspension stems from | Appeal basis | Accepted when the records show |
|---|---|---|
| A type on the plan-of-action list | plan of action | the plan addresses every active violation |
| A type on the plan-of-action list | any other basis | never — it is rejected |
| A type not on the plan-of-action list | plan of action | the plan addresses every active violation |
| A type not on the plan-of-action list | violation issued in error | the listing was not active, the complaint was retracted, or the violation was recorded twice |
